# Behance

> Behance is Adobe's creative portfolio platform connecting designers, illustrators, and creative professionals with opportunities for showcasing work, finding jobs, and hiring talent.

Behance serves as a comprehensive creative community where professionals across design disciplines can build portfolios, discover inspiration, and connect with clients and employers. The platform integrates with Adobe's ecosystem and offers both free and premium Pro subscription features for career acceleration.

## Core Platform

- [Search Projects](https://www.behance.net): Behance homepage: search and discover creative projects across design disciplines
- [About Behance](https://www.behance.net/about): About page explaining Behance platform mission and creative community benefits

## Jobs & Hiring

- [Find Creative Jobs](https://www.behance.net/joblist): Behance job marketplace for finding freelance and creative career opportunities
- [Hire Freelance Designers](https://www.behance.net/hire): Hire page for discovering and engaging freelance design talent on Behance
- [Create Project Flow](https://www.behance.net/hire/createProjectFlow): Project creation flow for posting freelance hiring requests on Behance

## Membership & Opportunities

- [Behance Pro](https://www.behance.net/pro): Behance Pro subscription page with premium features and pricing plans
- [Adobe Creative Apprenticeship Program](https://www.behance.net/resources/commissions): Adobe Creative Apprenticeship Program and commissioned project opportunities

## Community & Resources

- [Blog](https://www.behance.net/blog): Behance blog featuring design trends, creative news, and designer spotlights
- [Community Guidelines](https://www.behance.net/misc/community): Community guidelines and content policies for Behance platform safety
